verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents a native risk register, seeded from a NIST risk library, where each risk carries an inherent risk score, a treatment plan and a residual risk score (AI-assisted via Comply AI for Risk). The evidence does not show risk owners, recurring risk review cycles or linkage of risks to controls; the recurring reviews in docs-8 apply to vendor risk, which is a different feature. missing for 10: risk owner assignment, recurring risk review cycles, risk-to-control mapping, independent/hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a security engineer, a real risk register lives in the platform — scored risks, treatment plans, owners, and review cycles tied back to controls

citations.quote: Organizations can easily add these risks to their risk register for tracking.
Comply AI for Risk automates the risk assessment workflow by producing inherent risk score, treatment, residual risk score, and justifications.
Using a risk description, Comply AI for Risk produces an inherent risk score, treatment plan, and residual risk score
